newsitem.title: GERMANY: Continental sees clearly higher 96 profits.
newsitem.headline: Continental sees clearly higher 96 profits.

text.p: German tyre maker Continental AG expects clearly higher profit in the second half of this year after pre-tax profit more than doubled to 120 million marks in the first half, the company said on Tuesday.

Continental, the world's fourth largest tyre maker, said it expected sales for the year as a whole to climb 2.5 percent to 10.5 billion marks after first half sales climbed to 5.09 billion marks from 5.03 billion marks.
